profile.headline: Full Stack Senior Software Engineer 👩🏽‍💻 | Python, React, PostgreSQL, Pyramid | Mindfulness in Tech Advocate
profile.summary:
Full Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years building scalable web applications at LexisNexis, specializing in Python, React, and PostgreSQL. I thrive at the intersection of backend systems and intuitive UI design, with recent work including:

- Modernizing a QA testing tool with React + PostgreSQL to streamline error analysis
- Implementing AI-powered search feature improving search speed and user experience

Beyond engineering, I’m a certified MBSR facilitator passionate about bringing mindfulness into tech to help support healthier, more effective teams.

volunteerExperiences.description: Intuit - Superglue is a lineage-tracking tool built to help visualize the propagation of data through complex pipelines composed of tables, jobs and reports.

• Assist in building Machine Learning App to reach over 60 million students to teach computer science/data science concepts through real-world applications. 

• Utilize Git to manage GitHub repositories and protect the development cycle with version control to enhance collaborating in an open-source development environment with other engineers.

• Harness Redux to keep application state within a single source of truth,  reduce unwarranted prop drilling and orchestrate a scalable and predictable state management for ongoing open source contributions.
